response.rationale: D3 (Supraventricular Tachycardia) is strongly supported by multiple findings including regular nonexertional episodic palpitations, a heart rate of 120 beats/min, and regular narrow QRS tachycardia. D1 (Atrial Tachycardia) is also supported by ECG findings of regular narrow QRS tachycardia with P waves, but D3 has more comprehensive support from the vignette. D2 (Atrial Flutter) is contradicted by the variable first heart sound. D4 (Ventricular Tachycardia) is only supported by the heart rate, which is not specific enough to make it a strong candidate given the narrow QRS.
